Game Overview

At its heart, Blocky VS Zombies is a building game about battle through a blocky world as a dynamic archer-lumberjack, vanquishing endless zombie hordes. Upgrade your skills by chopping wood and crafting precise shots to conquer fierce bosses. Balance speed and accuracy to repair a magical portal and escape this pixelated peril in a thrilling race against time!

Each session of Blocky VS Zombies follows a consistent rhythm. Battle through a blocky world as a dynamic archer-lumberjack, vanquishing endless zombie hordes. Upgrade your skills by chopping wood and crafting precise shots to conquer fierce bosses. Balance speed and accuracy to repair a magical portal and escape this pixelated peril in a thrilling race against time!
